frames.commentary: I want to build this man myself, not take one off a shelf.

frames.action: press 'Return' -- take the Custom Character entry
frames.commentary: I would rather build this man myself than accept somebody else.

frames.action: press 'f' -- finish the world settings as they stand
frames.commentary: The town is already what it is. Nothing here wants changing by me.

frames.action: press 'shift+Tab' -- move back to the points pool page
frames.commentary: First I want to know what I am allowed to be. Then I will spend it.

frames.action: press 'Down' -- move down to the multiple-pools budget

frames.action: press 'Tab' -- move to the scenario page
frames.commentary: Now: how did I come to be here at all? There is only one true answer.

frames.action: press 'slash' -- narrow the list of starts
frames.commentary: I have no patience for scrolling. I know the word I am looking for.

frames.action: press 'm' -- begin spelling the start I want
frames.commentary: I did not fight my way out of anything.
I was asleep with the fan on, in the middle of the afternoon.
No shelter. No convoy. No warning that I was awake to hear.
Spell it out plainly and it stops being shameful. It is just what happened.
Missed. It has the decency to be accurate, which is more than I manage.

frames.action: press 'Tab' -- move to the trade page
frames.commentary: Thirty-four years of it. There is no question what I put down here.
I know the word. I wore it on a hat for most of my life.
Mail.
Three routes, all of them inside two miles of this table.
Neither snow nor rain, they told us, and we believed it enough to walk.
That is the whole of what I am qualified for.
One entry. I never was a man of many options.

frames.action: press 'Return' -- take the mail carrier trade
frames.commentary: Mail carrier. A hat, a bag, a whistle, and the watch on my wrist.

frames.action: press 'Tab' -- move on from the trade
frames.commentary: The schooling and the licence I will take as they are. They are true enough.

frames.action: press 'Tab' -- move to the body page
frames.commentary: Now the body I actually have, and not the one I would have ordered.

frames.action: press 'Down' -- move down to the hands
frames.commentary: Next, the hands.

frames.action: press 'Down' -- move down to the head
frames.commentary: And then the part of me that has not worn out.

And I can still do arithmetic on my feet, which today will matter.

frames.action: press 'Down' -- move down to the eyes
frames.commentary: Last, the eyes. This is the only part of me I have actually earned.
Thirty-four years of being paid to see whether a house was right.
A door open a hand width when it was shut yesterday. I see that.
A shape in a yard that is the wrong shape for a yard.

frames.action: press 'Tab' -- move to the traits page

frames.action: press 'k' -- begin spelling the first flaw

A short word for a long complaint.

frames.action: press 'f' -- begin spelling the second flaw

Admitting it buys me something. I would rather be honest and pay for it.
Now what that admission is for. Three things, and they are all one thing.

frames.action: press 'a' -- begin spelling the first boon

frames.action: press 'h' -- begin spelling the second boon
